steps.title: Craft bronze pickaxe
steps.hints: Run craft_plan for 'Bronze Pickaxe' first. If it is makeable from what he carries, walk to station_1 and craft it, then equip it. If the plan shows a missing material, skip the upgrade and go on to mining.

steps.title: Mine ore
steps.hints: Look for copper or tin rock nearby and gather it with the best pickaxe equipped. If no rock is in sight, walk around and look again. Stop if the bag is nearly full.
